render: For each worker profile, emit dist/qwen-code/agents/agenticale/<name>.md carrying the Qwen Code agent frontmatter — name 'agenticale-<name>' (must match the filename; colons and slashes are invalid in agent names), the profile's description, maxTurns (the profile's turn ceiling), background: false, and the disallowedTools list rendered from the profile's permission policy — plus the matching neutral task-contract body copied from skills/work/references/tasks/<role>.md (implement, implement-easy, and implement-hard all use implement.md; consult and consult-hard both use consult.md). The model for that role is taken from the flat model config at build time (adapters/qwen-code/models.json by default, or the --models option): a value whose provider equals codex.providerPrefix renders an executor block (kind codex, the codex command, and -c overrides pinning the model and the clamped reasoning effort) instead of a model line; any other listed provider renders one model line in provider-qualified '<provider>:<model>' form; an unlisted role renders neither, so the profile inherits the session model (a codex-routed role renders only when listed, because the executor cannot inherit). The seven base roles always render, one profile per role; the optional implement-easy and consult-hard profiles render only when the config lists them explicitly. When the config carries the top-level coordinator key, the build additionally emits the coordinator agent file from the coordinator entry below (body copied from the adapter-owned coordinator.md); Qwen Code has no session-primary agent concept, so the coordinating session adopts that body and model per the runtime binding.

profiles.name: explore
profiles.description: Focused reconnaissance of project or external source for one tightly scoped question.

profiles.name: implement
profiles.description: Implements one small, verifiable implementation slice.

profiles.name: implement-easy
profiles.description: Implements one routine implementation slice (easy-task dispatch context).

profiles.name: implement-hard
profiles.description: Implements one reasoning-heavy implementation slice (hard-task dispatch context).

profiles.name: fix
profiles.description: Addresses only the specified review findings in a fix pass.

profiles.name: review
profiles.description: Independent high-reasoning review of one completed implementation slice.

profiles.name: review-deep
profiles.description: Expensive, integration-level audit of several accepted implementation slices.

profiles.name: consult
profiles.description: Independent second opinion on one stuck technical decision; read-only, returns one recommendation.

profiles.name: consult-hard
profiles.description: Independent second opinion on one reasoning-heavy stuck technical decision; read-only, returns one recommendation.

coordinator.name: coordinator
coordinator.description: Workflow coordinator session: plans bounded slices, dispatches worker children, and integrates their reports.
